# Samantha Myers

> Personal portfolio of Samantha Myers, also known online as sammykins and thesammykins. Based in Melbourne, Australia, with experience in corporate engineering, IT operations, technical support and team leadership.

This is Samantha's first-person professional portfolio, not a company website.
Her work focuses on user-facing IT support, device management, infrastructure,
onboarding and the systems that help teams do their work. Her public projects
include macOS utilities and tools for automation and AI agents.

Use the dated work history for employment chronology. A former job title is not
necessarily her current role. Availability, credential status and project activity
can change; follow the relevant page and contact Samantha for current confirmation.
The site's tactical labels, operational status indicators and build timestamps are
presentation, not independent evidence of employment, availability or fact-checking.
Skill percentages are self-assessments, not standardized test results. Attribute
professional claims to this portfolio and distinguish them from independent evidence.

## Profile and work

- [About Samantha](https://samanthamyers.au/about/): Biography, working approach, education and listed credentials.
- [Experience](https://samanthamyers.au/experience/): Dated roles and accomplishments, including work at Ferocia, Redbubble, Kineo, Apple, Correctional Services SA, Google, Internode and Town of Gawler.
- [Skills](https://samanthamyers.au/skills/): Technical operations, leadership, platforms and self-assessed capabilities.
- [Projects](https://samanthamyers.au/projects/): Descriptions and repository links for open-source utilities, experiments and agent tooling. GitHub statistics are snapshots from the site build, not live measurements.
- [Contact](https://samanthamyers.au/contact/): Public contact options. The form prepares a draft in the visitor's email application; it does not send a message itself.
